meta.title: Project — Built in the open
meta.description: A modular project homepage with capabilities, workflow, proof, and clear ways to get started.

hero.headline: Make complex work feel clear.
hero.body: A focused project can be powerful, understandable, and ready to extend without hiding how it works.

items.title: Focused core
items.body: Keep the primary path small, understandable, and dependable.

items.title: Friendly interface
items.body: Start with conventions that help newcomers reach a useful result quickly.

items.title: Composable design
items.body: Combine independent modules without losing one source of truth.

items.title: Open integration
items.body: Connect the project to the tools and environments around it.

items.title: Auditable flow
items.body: Make important inputs, transitions, and outcomes easy to inspect.

items.title: Portable output
items.body: Produce artifacts that remain useful outside one runtime or conversation.

workflow.title: A visible path from input to outcome.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Read the real context and constraints.

steps.title: Verify
steps.body: Check the produced result, not a claim about it.

workflow.aside: Each step stays inspectable and replaceable.

cta.headline: Start with a path you can inspect.
cta.body: Try the project, read its documentation, and adapt the modular pieces to your own work.

footer.summary: An open project built around clear boundaries, useful artifacts, and verifiable outcomes.
